title: Marko
subtitle: Content OS for creators and agencies. Everything from the first idea to the published post lives in one tab.
about:
What is Marko?

Creators and small agencies run their work across six apps: Notion for ideas, Google Docs for scripts, a native app for drafts, the camera roll for assets, a scheduler for publishing, and six different native dashboards for analytics. Marko puts all of that in one place.

It's a single workspace that covers the whole lifecycle of a post: saving inspiration, writing scripts, composing the post with a live preview, scheduling it on a calendar, and reading the numbers after it goes out.

challenge.title: The problem: the workflow is scattered
challenge.description: Serious creators post across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and Facebook. Without one place to run it all from, ideas get lost, posts drift, and analytics live in six different dashboards.

cards.title: Scattered pipelines
cards.description: Scripts in Docs, ideas in Notion, drafts in native apps, analytics on each platform. No single source of truth.

cards.title: No cross-platform view
cards.description: No way to see the full publishing schedule or audience growth across every platform at once.

cards.title: Blank page problem
cards.description: Without a system to resurface saved inspiration, creators lost hours staring at an empty draft.

solution.title: The solution: one tab, the whole workflow
solution.description: Marko covers every step of the content loop in one app: save a reference in the Vault, write the script, compose the post with a mobile preview, schedule it on the calendar, and read the analytics afterwards.

features.title: Visual calendar
features.description: An editorial calendar that plans and schedules posts across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and Facebook from one view.

features.title: Inspiration Vault
features.description: A personal library for videos, images and references. Marko reads it to suggest ideas that fit the creator's style.

features.title: Composer with live preview
features.description: Multi-pane post editor with real-time mobile previews so the post looks right on every platform before it goes live.

techStack.title: How it's built
techStack.description: Modern web stack picked for speed and developer sanity.

categories.name: Frontend
categories.description: Next.js 15 App Router with TypeScript and Tailwind. Framer Motion for the transitions and micro-interactions.

categories.name: Backend & auth
categories.description: Supabase for auth with Row Level Security, Postgres, real-time subscriptions, and bucket storage for media.

categories.name: AI layer
categories.description: Marko AI reads the Vault and engagement history to suggest posting times, structures, and daily prompts.

results.title: One tab, not six
results.description: Replaces Notion, Docs, native analytics, and scheduling apps for the creator workflow.

results.title: Cross-platform numbers
results.description: Reach, engagement, follower growth and top posts across every connected platform in one dashboard.

results.title: A cadence that holds
results.description: Daily suggestions from the Vault keep the schedule moving instead of waiting for inspiration to strike.
